_description: Regression test for the missing-<measurements>-path bug (fixed 21 Aug 2026): loads the default fixture measurements (fixtures/measurements/sample.smis, via --measurements), creates one point using a measurement-referencing formula ('shoulder_length'), and dumps it. run_batch's own bespoke checkMeasurementsPathRegression() (main.cpp) does the real assertions this case exists for: that the saved pattern.val this case produces (via --save-pattern, same as every other case) has a non-empty <measurements> element resolving back to sample.smis, and that reloading that saved file with NO --measurements flag still resolves 'shoulder_length' to the same coordinate as this run -- proving VAbstractPattern::SetMPath() is actually being called after a measurement load, not just that the in-process VContainer looks right.
